description: Sets whether the app lives on the web, as a mobile app, or both — read before go-live to shape which proofs it asks for (a web app's secret scan proves nothing about a phone bundle, so changing this clears any stored scan; go-live asks again). Before go-live it acts at once; once live, the founder approves it in the browser (request_app_lives).
name: set_app_lives
title: Set where the app lives
